premises.text: There is a labor crisis in the US across multiple industries impacting the economy negatively
premises.evidence_span: there is a labor crisis in the US across the construction, agriculture, restaurant, and manufacturing industries having a $1 trillion negative impact on the US economy

premises.text: Current robotic innovation does not translate well to everyday automation
premises.evidence_span: Robotic innovation has focused on factory automation that doesn't translate well to everyday automation

premises.text: Industrial robots are limited by their design and precision requirements
premises.evidence_span: These industrial robots have big external control boxes with difficult-to-manufacture strainwave gears and legacy PLCs, limiting where robots need to go in the future

premises.text: The Ally arm can significantly expand the market for robotic technology and everyday automation
premises.evidence_span: With a combination of machine vision, imitation learning, AI, and hardware innovation, we can significantly expand the market for robotic technology and everyday automation

premises.text: The Ally arm is designed to be affordable and easy to service
premises.evidence_span: The Ally arm is the smartest, most affordable, easy-to-service, and simple-to-train robotic arm

premises.text: The Ally arm allows for programming through human gestures
premises.evidence_span: even my five-year-old will be able to program the robot by showing it, and the robot will then repeat that task

value.text: Robotics can be made accessible and usable for anyone, anywhere
value.evidence_span: together, we're enabling robotics for anyone, anywhere

notes: Collaboration with NVIDIA and customer contracts are excluded as traction.
